hero.sub: A unified workspace where multiple AI agents operate in parallel — each with its own terminal, worktree, and permissions — while you stay in control.
compare.title: Built for
compare.sub: Stop duct-taping terminals, editors, and scripts together. One workspace for everything your agents need.
compare.good_note: ✓ Agent-native, ready out of the box
deep.desc1: Run a fleet of AI agents on a single project — review bot, doc writer, test generator — each isolated, all under one roof. Claude Code, Auggie, or any ACP-compatible agent.
deep.desc2: Spawn autonomous agent instances with configurable permissions, scheduling, and lifecycle management. They work while you sleep.
deep.feat1: Auto-approve mode — agents run without interruption
deep.feat2: Keep-alive — auto-restart on crash, up to 3 retries
deep.feat3: Skill system — reusable prompt + tooling packages
deep.feat4: Permission guardrails — trust levels per claw
feat.title: Built for
feat.sub: Everything your agents need. Nothing they don't.
feat.terminal_desc: Full PTY terminal with xterm.js. Colors, cursor movement, interactive programs — a real terminal, not a console.
feat.chat_desc: WebSocket-based chat with real-time streaming, tool call visualization, and message history across sessions.
feat.git_desc: Staging, commits, branches, merge editor, and diff viewer. Powered by git2 for speed, git CLI for mutations.
feat.worktrees_desc: Each agent gets its own git worktree. Parallel refactors without branch conflicts — diff, review, merge from sidebar.
feat.skills_desc: Package prompt + tooling into reusable Skills. Attach to any claw. Versioned, shareable, discoverable.
feat.permissions_desc: Auto-approve, bypass, or review step-by-step. Permission modes per claw — sensible defaults, full control.
usecase.title: Who ships
usecase.solo_desc: A fleet of agents behind you. Ship like a 10-person startup.
usecase.enterprise_desc: Team-scale agent orchestration with centralized management, permissions, and audit trails.
usecase.platform_desc: Ship migrations across services in parallel. One spec, many worktrees.
usecase.agency_desc: Run a claw farm per client. Separate billing, separate skills, one cockpit.
roadmap.title: Building the
roadmap.sub: Rapidly evolving. Here's what's shipping now, what's in the lab, and what lies beyond.
roadmap.terminal_desc: Full terminal emulator with xterm.js, slash commands, cross-platform shell support.
roadmap.git_desc: Staging, commits, branches, merge editor, diff viewer. git2 + git CLI hybrid.
roadmap.chat_desc: WebSocket chat with real-time streaming, tool call visualization, message history.
roadmap.acp_desc: Agent Client Protocol support for connecting any compatible AI agent natively.
roadmap.desktop_desc: Tauri v2 native desktop app with sidecar binary and system tray integration.
roadmap.marketplace_desc: Discover and install community skills, themes, and agent configurations.
cta.sub: Available on macOS, Linux & Windows. Install via npm.
